newsitem.title: USA: Wheels Sports completes public offering.
newsitem.headline: Wheels Sports completes public offering.

text.p: Wheels Sports Group Inc said Friday it had completed its initial public offering of 900,000 shares of common stock and 900,000 common stock purchase warrants at a combined offering price of $6.00 for one share and one warrant, or $5.90 per share and $0.10 per warrant.

Wheels Sports said it expects to receive net proceeds of approximately $4.27 million from the offering, which it will use to promote and operate the company's new interactive NASCAR-oriented fantasy race game, Fantasy World Racing, and to repay bank loans, among other projects.

The common stock purchase warrants will be exercisable over the next five years, subject to the company's right to redeem the warrants under certain circumstances, the company said. Two warrants entitle the holder to purchase one share of common stock for $7.08 per share.
Underwriter Schneider Securities Inc has an overallotment option for up to another 135,000 shares.
Wheels Sports designs, markets and distributes sports trading cards.
